headlines.text: Nvidia reports fiscal Q3 results after today's close in Colette Kress's first earnings call as interim CEO since Jensen Huang's exit, with Wall Street modeling $2.47-$2.48 EPS on roughly $109B revenue
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned Nov. 12 after 33 years; CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO and Harvey Jones became the company's first board chair ahead of today's earnings
Dow sheds over 750 points and Nasdaq extends its slide Tuesday as stocks book a third-plus straight losing session jittery ahead of Nvidia's results tonight
U.S. retail sales growth slowed to 0.2% in October from September's 0.8%, though core sales excluding autos, gas and building materials rose a stronger-than-expected 0.6%
Anthropic set to price its IPO Wednesday at $70-$78 a share, valuing the AI firm near $1.4 trillion ahead of Thursday's Nasdaq debut under ticker ANT

Fed's Oct. 27-28 meeting minutes, due out Wednesday, expected to detail the 10-2 vote to hold rates at 3.75%-4%, with Cook and Hammack's dissents favoring a hike underscoring little room for a December cut
